name: @pipeworx/mcp-trademarks

tools.name: search_trademarks
tools.description: Search US federal trademarks by mark text — the clearance/knockout-search path. Find registered and pending marks by wordmark without knowing a serial or registration number, then filter by international class and live/dead status to see which marks are actually enforceable. Also finds every mark held by a company: pass owner (e.g. "Nike") to list the trademark portfolio of a brand owner. Covers the full USPTO register (the Trademark Search system that replaced TESS). Keyless. Use this to check whether a proposed brand name conflicts with existing US trademarks. Returns wordmark, serial and registration numbers, status, live flag, international classes, goods/services, owners of record with role and entity type, attorney of record, filing dates, and data_as_of (when USPTO last loaded each record). For a name-availability check, set live_only:true and pass the relevant class (e.g. 35 for advertising/business, 42 for software/SaaS, 9 for downloadable software).

query.description: Mark text to screen (e.g. "TenderBrief"). Matches the wordmark field. Required unless owner is given. Advanced: pass fielded Lucene (e.g. 'wordmark:apple AND ownerName:"Apple Inc"') and it is used verbatim.

international_class.description: Optional Nice class filter. Accepts "35", 35, "IC 035", or "035". Common: 9 (software), 35 (advertising/business/retail), 42 (SaaS/tech services).

live_only.description: If true, return only live marks (registered or pending) — the set that can actually block a new application. Default false (includes dead/abandoned/cancelled).

owner.description: Owner-name filter (e.g. "Nike", "Mondelez"). Pass owner alone (no query) to list that owner's whole portfolio.

tools.name: get_trademark_by_serial
tools.description: Look up one US trademark by its 8-digit serial (application) number: mark text, current status and live flag, registration number, owners of record, attorney of record, filing/registration/publication/renewal dates, filing basis, international classes and goods/services, with data_as_of. Keyless. Optional api_key switches to USPTO's TSDR case-status record instead.

api_key.description: Optional USPTO TSDR API key (free at account.uspto.gov/api-manager). Omit for the keyless register record.

tools.name: get_trademark_by_registration
tools.description: Look up one US trademark by its registration number (e.g. "4872338"): mark text, serial number, current status and live flag, owners of record, attorney of record, registration/renewal/cancellation dates, international classes and goods/services, with data_as_of. Keyless. Optional api_key switches to USPTO's TSDR case-status record instead.

api_key.description: Optional USPTO TSDR API key. Omit for the keyless register record.

tools.name: get_trademark_documents
tools.description: Get the prosecution history (office actions, responses, etc.) for a trademark by serial number. Requires USPTO API key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-trademarks forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the trademarks pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
